$comment: Reviewed npm advisory acceptances. Enforced by scripts/check-npm-audit.mjs.
Two-way: an unlisted moderate+ advisory fails, and an entry whose advisory is
gone fails so an acceptance cannot outlive its risk. Every entry needs a
reason, and the reason must be why the code is UNREACHABLE in the shipped
desktop app or why no fix exists — never that upgrading is inconvenient.
Added by audit 20260906 (C3), which found the gate disabled at
continue-on-error for a pnpm-410 problem that no longer reproduces.

GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9.reason: Dev-server path traversal in the website's VitePress toolchain. Same non-shipped dev-server surface as GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff.

GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99.reason: esbuild dev server, reached through website>vitepress>vite. Build-time only; no esbuild server runs in the app or in CI's built output.

GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr.reason: esbuild dev-server file read via server__content>tsup. Build-time bundling only; tsup never starts a server here.
